lines: The scarecrow group all bounced skillfully on their one leg to assault us.
Be careful!! Don't let them catch you or it'll hurt!!
Hehehe... Humans, be our comrades... More of us...
Aiiieee!? That one is saying some pretty freaky stuuuuff!!
Come here, you two! Grab onto Hebiko!!!
Before I knew it, Hebiko had turned into an octopus and was bracing herself.
We desperately grasped onto the octopus tentacles as we were chased by the scarecrows.
Hold tight you two! Here goes... Beast Jutsu: Octo-Jump!!!
Using her tentacles as springs Hebiko launched us high into the air...
and in an instant, we flew right to the entrance of Yukikaze's castle.
Fortunately, it seemed that the door wasn't locked.
We landed with a somersault, opening that large door as we did, and jumped straight in.
